1934, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 176 Cont.
Feb. 21 Eliz. Lux - 6 - kidney stones operation averted - prayed for 3 week ago and enrolled for kidney-stones, O.K. now.
Page 177
Feb. 28 Edw'd Jos. LaPointe - 7 - mentally subnormal.
Harry Brower - 43 ....
Sam. Gripi - 43 - drifting to pante Co. - steals .... crazy
Mrs. Nellie Morrissey - 50 - asthma, flu, sinus - boy studying .... Rose Mason's brother - has wife and five small children - has quite lost mind.
Mrs. E. killoran - 73 - stroke & pneum'a
Seward Greenfield - 52 - Episcopelian - cancer - just started to work after yrs.
Christain Haag - 35 - over - lifted about a month ago - got bad rup- ture. Operation failed to help. In bad condition. Has wife and child dependent. Enrolled To-day promising weekly Communion if helped.
Dr. Mercier - about 60 - David Whitney Bld'g recovering from remark- able "blood" transfusion. Has for many years been giving his blood to poor patients. Four months ago offered his blood for a poor re- ligious. By mistake the doctor in charge took 99% instead of 33, in consequence .. could not stand up after said transfusion and had to stay four months in bed. He is a specialist. He does not profess any religious denom ....... Is now practicing medicine again but is weak.
Stations To-night.
1934, March
Page 178 Mar. 1 Camiel Flamez - 20 - operated a year ago for tumor on brain. It was so close to the brain that operation had to be abandoned .... treated with X ray was able to work for a time but now threatened again with same. He is enrolled To-day for two yrs.
(Rev) Mr. James Kirkman - Methodist - in Kiefer Hospital - T.B. Hopeless, discouraged. ...
